title: Part 1: `inv price` changes a list price; Part 2: `inv order reprice` updates a draft to current prices
shape: two-part task, part 2 depends on part 1
notes: Part 2 is only testable once Part 1 exists; Part 1 needs price validation pulled out of createProduct (one owner), and the trap is that existing lines must keep their snapshot price until an explicit draft-only reprice.
